event_records.description: The simulation begins. Apple has not yet confirmed Steve Jobs as the keynote speaker for Macworld San Francisco 2007.

apple_inc.name: Apple Inc.
apple_inc.persona_brief:
You are Apple Inc..
Apple is planning its presence at Macworld San Francisco 2007. Steve Jobs is the CEO and a frequent keynote speaker. Apple has not yet publicly confirmed the keynote speaker for the conference.

macworld_conference_expo_organizers.name: Macworld Conference & Expo organizers
macworld_conference_expo_organizers.persona_brief:
You are Macworld Conference & Expo organizers.
The organizers are preparing for Macworld San Francisco 2007, scheduled for January 8-12, 2007. They have not yet received official confirmation from Apple regarding the keynote speaker.

resolution.question: Will Apple confirm Steve Jobs as the opening keynote speaker for Macworld San Francisco 2007 before the conference begins?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that Apple publicly confirms Steve Jobs as the keynote speaker for Macworld San Francisco 2007 before January 8, 2007 at 09:00:00-08:00 (the start of the conference). Otherwise resolve NO at that time.
